capabilities: write journal entries and run multi-perspective AI analyses on them
chat with the AI from a specific analysis perspective and save the chat back into the note
draft goals from analyses and consolidate similar goals and milestone notes
sync goals and milestones into the Full Calendar plugin
review journaling activity in an emotional intelligence dashboard
extras: Licensed under AGPL-3.0. Extensive safety and privacy warnings: it is not a medical device or therapy substitute, journal content is sent to the selected AI provider, and the OpenAI API key is stored locally in plugin data. Beta installs go through BRAT; full analyses with all 262 frames enabled can produce roughly 62,750 words per entry.
motivation: The author, studying theories of self at university, wondered what it would be like if those theories could work as therapy, and built the plugin as a form of theoretical therapy using OpenAI's Codex.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to analyze journal entries through multiple intellectual frameworks or turn reflective insights into tracked goals and milestones.

relations.evidence: optionally sync goals and milestones into the Full Calendar plugin
OpenAI mode sends context to OpenAI.
Local Ollama mode sends context only to the configured local endpoint

summary: AI journaling plugin that analyzes journal entries through hundreds of theoretical perspectives, with reflective chat, goal drafting, and milestone tracking.
